properties.text: Total ether must be conserved across move_ether: sender debit equals recipient credit.
properties.assertion: forall move_ether(s, from, to, amt): balance(s', from) == balance(s, from) - amt AND balance(s', to) == balance(s, to) + amt

properties.text: move_ether must revert when sender balance is insufficient.
properties.assertion: forall move_ether(s, from, to, amt): balance(s, from) < amt => revert(AssertionError)

properties.text: Transaction gas must be >= max(intrinsic_gas, calldata_floor) per EIP-7623.
properties.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.gas >= max(intrinsic_gas(tx), calldata_floor(tx)) OR raise InsufficientTransactionGasError

properties.text: Transaction gas must not exceed TX_MAX_GAS_LIMIT (16,777,216) per EIP-7825.
properties.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.gas <= 16777216 OR raise TransactionGasLimitExceededError

properties.text: Signature r value must be in range (0, SECP256K1N) for valid sender recovery.
properties.assertion: forall recover_sender(tx): 0 < tx.r < SECP256K1N OR raise InvalidSignatureError

properties.text: Signature s value must satisfy low-s rule: 0 < s <= SECP256K1N/2.
properties.assertion: forall recover_sender(tx): 0 < tx.s <= SECP256K1N / 2 OR raise InvalidSignatureError

properties.text: Rollback must restore state to the exact snapshot captured by begin_transaction.
properties.assertion: forall rollback(s): s._main_trie == snapshot_trie AND s._storage_tries == snapshot_storage

properties.text: Transient storage must be restored to snapshot state on rollback.
properties.assertion: forall rollback(s): transient._tries == transient_snapshot

properties.text: begin_transaction must create deep copies of tries so in-flight mutations don't corrupt snapshots.
properties.assertion: forall begin_tx(s): id(snapshot.main_trie) != id(s._main_trie) AND snapshot.main_trie == s._main_trie

properties.text: commit_transaction clears created_accounts only when last snapshot is popped.
properties.assertion: forall commit_tx(s): len(s._snapshots) == 0 => s.created_accounts == {} AND len(s._snapshots) > 0 => s.created_accounts unchanged

properties.text: set_storage must assert account exists before writing storage.
properties.assertion: forall set_storage(s, addr, k, v): trie_get(s._main_trie, addr) != None

properties.text: Empty storage tries must be cleaned up after set_storage zeros all keys.
properties.assertion: forall set_storage(s, addr, k, v): trie._data == {} => addr not in s._storage_tries

properties.text: destroy_account must remove both the account and its storage trie.
properties.assertion: forall destroy_account(s, addr): trie_get(s._main_trie, addr) == None AND addr not in s._storage_tries

properties.text: modify_state must auto-destroy empty accounts (nonce=0, code=b'', balance=0).
properties.assertion: forall modify_state(s, addr, f): account'.nonce==0 AND account'.code==b'' AND account'.balance==0 => destroy_account(s, addr)

properties.text: Nonce must increment by exactly 1 per increment_nonce call.
properties.assertion: forall increment_nonce(s, addr): nonce(s', addr) == nonce(s, addr) + 1

properties.text: Transaction nonce must be less than U64.MAX_VALUE to prevent overflow.
properties.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): U256(tx.nonce) < U256(U64.MAX_VALUE) OR raise NonceOverflowError

properties.text: Contract creation initcode must not exceed MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE.
properties.assertion: forall validate_tx(tx): tx.to == Bytes0 => len(tx.data) <= MAX_INIT_CODE_SIZE OR raise InitCodeTooLargeError

properties.text: decode_transaction must reject unknown type prefixes with TransactionTypeError.
properties.assertion: forall decode_tx(raw): raw[0] not in {1,2,3,4} AND not LegacyTransaction => raise TransactionTypeError

properties.text: encode and decode must be inverse: decode(encode(tx)) == tx for all valid types.
properties.assertion: forall tx in ValidTransaction: decode_transaction(encode_transaction(tx)) == tx

properties.text: Legacy transaction v must be 27, 28, or valid EIP-155 encoding for sender recovery.
properties.assertion: forall recover_sender(tx): is_legacy(tx) => tx.v in {27,28} OR is_eip155(tx.v) OR raise InvalidSignatureError

properties.text: Typed transaction y_parity must be 0 or 1.
properties.assertion: forall recover_sender(tx): is_typed(tx) => tx.y_parity in {0, 1} OR raise InvalidSignatureError

properties.text: Each signing hash function must include its type prefix byte in the hash preimage.
properties.assertion: forall signing_hash_T(tx): hash_preimage starts with type_byte(T) for T in {2930,1559,4844,7702}

properties.text: P2P peers are untrusted; all transaction bytes from P2P must be fully validated before processing.
properties.assertion: forall p2p_msg(raw): decode_transaction(raw) succeeds => validate_transaction(tx) AND recover_sender(tx) before execution

properties.text: State root must not be computed while transaction snapshots are active.
properties.assertion: forall state_root(s): len(s._snapshots) == 0

properties.text: Storage root must not be computed while transaction snapshots are active.
properties.assertion: forall storage_root(s, addr): len(s._snapshots) == 0

properties.text: get_account must never return None; returns EMPTY_ACCOUNT for non-existent addresses.
properties.assertion: forall get_account(s, addr): result != None AND (addr not in trie => result == EMPTY_ACCOUNT)

properties.text: get_storage must return U256(0) for keys without a storage trie.
properties.assertion: forall get_storage(s, addr, k): addr not in s._storage_tries => result == U256(0)

properties.text: close_state must release all state references (trie, storage, snapshots, created_accounts).
properties.assertion: forall close_state(s): s._main_trie deleted AND s._storage_tries deleted AND s._snapshots deleted AND s.created_accounts deleted

properties.text: Transient storage must return U256(0) for unset keys.
properties.assertion: forall get_transient_storage(ts, addr, k): addr not in ts._tries => result == U256(0)

properties.text: Empty transient storage tries must be cleaned up to prevent state bloat.
properties.assertion: forall set_transient_storage(ts, addr, k, v): trie._data == {} => addr not in ts._tries

properties.text: get_storage_original must return U256(0) for newly created accounts regardless of current storage.
properties.assertion: forall get_storage_original(s, addr, k): addr in s.created_accounts => result == U256(0)

properties.text: get_storage_original must read from outermost (first) snapshot for pre-existing accounts.
properties.assertion: forall get_storage_original(s, addr, k): addr not in s.created_accounts => value from s._snapshots[0]

properties.text: EIP-155 signing hash must include chain_id to prevent cross-chain replay.
properties.assertion: forall signing_hash_155(tx): hash_preimage contains (chain_id, 0, 0) suffix

properties.text: EIP-4844 signing hash must bind blob_versioned_hashes and max_fee_per_blob_gas to signature.
properties.assertion: forall signing_hash_4844(tx): hash_preimage contains max_fee_per_blob_gas AND blob_versioned_hashes

properties.text: EIP-7702 signing hash must bind authorizations list to signature.
properties.assertion: forall signing_hash_7702(tx): hash_preimage contains authorizations

properties.text: Calldata floor cost must use EIP-7623 token formula: zero=1 token, nonzero=4 tokens.
properties.assertion: forall calc_intrinsic(tx): tokens == zero_bytes*1 + nonzero_bytes*4 AND floor == tokens*FLOOR_CALLDATA_COST + TX_BASE_COST

properties.text: SetCodeTransaction (EIP-7702) intrinsic cost must include PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST per authorization.
properties.assertion: forall calc_intrinsic(tx): is_7702(tx) => auth_cost == PER_EMPTY_ACCOUNT_COST * len(tx.authorizations)

properties.text: Snapshot count must increase by exactly 1 after begin_transaction.
properties.assertion: forall begin_tx(s): len(s'._snapshots) == len(s._snapshots) + 1

properties.text: Snapshot count must decrease by exactly 1 after commit_transaction.
properties.assertion: forall commit_tx(s): len(s'._snapshots) == len(s._snapshots) - 1

properties.text: mark_account_created persists even if account creation reverts, for EIP-6780 SELFDESTRUCT semantics.
properties.assertion: forall mark_account_created(s, addr): addr in s.created_accounts persists across rollbacks within same tx depth

properties.text: is_account_alive must return false for both non-existent and EMPTY_ACCOUNT entries.
properties.assertion: forall is_account_alive(s, addr): (get_account_optional(s, addr) == None OR get_account_optional(s, addr) == EMPTY_ACCOUNT) => false

properties.text: State root computation must incorporate all individual storage roots.
properties.assertion: forall state_root(s): root(s._main_trie) includes get_storage_root(addr) for all addr in s._storage_tries

properties.text: set_account_balance sets exact amount, not delta; empty account cleanup follows via modify_state.
properties.assertion: forall set_account_balance(s, addr, amt): balance(s', addr) == amt

properties.text: set_code via modify_state may trigger destroy if resulting account is empty.
properties.assertion: forall set_code(s, addr, b''): account'.nonce==0 AND account'.balance==0 => destroy_account(s, addr)

properties.text: Transaction hash must cover the full encoded payload including type prefix for typed transactions.
properties.assertion: forall get_tx_hash(tx): is_typed(tx) => keccak256(type_byte + rlp_encoded(tx)) AND is_legacy(tx) => keccak256(rlp_encoded(tx))
